entry.name: shiftright
entry.description: Shifts all bit values to the right. This has the effect of dividing a number by a power of two, but is less expensive in computer resources.

arguments.name: initial-value
arguments.digest: Number of bits positions to shift
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the number of bits by which to shift rightward.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Performs the bit-shift with the numbers currently stored. If there is no argument,initially holdsas the number of bits by which to shift.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Number of bits to shift rightward
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as the number of bits to right-shift the number in the left inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: All bits of the number, in binary form, are shifted to the right by a certain number of bits. The resulting number is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Shift the first value by the second value
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number is bit-shifted to the right by the number of bits specified by the second number.

messages.description: Sets input to the object without causing output (will output it).
